## Ctx.broadcastMedia() method

Sends a media message to multiple users in bulk.

**Signature:**

```typescript
broadcastMedia(ids: number[], languageCode: string[], keyboard?: ITInBoKb, data?: ITData, baseId?: string, options?: ITOptReplyPhoto | ITOptReplyVideo | ITOptReplyAudio | ITOptReplyDocument | ITOptReplyAnimation | ITOptReplyVoice | ITOptReplyVideoNote | ITOptReplySticker | ITOptReplyLocation | ITOptReplyContact, throwError?: boolean): Promise<{
        successCount: number;
        failedCount: number;
        totalCount: number;
    }>;
```

## Remarks

Media type and arg are inferred from the template `<g-media>` block. If a supported media type (`photo`<!-- -->, `video`<!-- -->, `audio`<!-- -->, `document`<!-- -->) uses a pipe-delimited `src`<!-- -->, it is sent as a Telegram media group. Telegram media groups do not support reply markup, so keyboards are ignored for grouped media. Automatically throttles after 30 messages to respect Telegram rate limits. Uses each user's specified language code for template rendering.

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackData() {
  const userIds = [123456, 789012]
  const langs = ["en", "id"]
  await this.broadcastMedia(userIds, langs)
}
```
